title: Software Evolution Simulator — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Tests how alternative architectures, dependencies, and design decisions affect long-term maintainability and performance. A proposed simulator that projects a software project into the future: given alternative architectures, dependency choices, and design decisions, it simulates years of maintenance — feature additions, staff turnover, dependency rot — and reports which choices lead to maintainable, performant systems and which lead to collapse.
capabilities: Compare design decisions side by side
Identify decisions that most affect long-term health
